'''Gikkin''' was the founder and commander of the [[Crimson Aces]]. Until the early days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], the Crimson Aces had been the space defense force of [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Repea]], near the [[Cron Drift/Legends|Cron Drift]]; but fearful and avaricious Repean politicians feared the Aces would turn against them and in concert with the Empire, they wiped out the Aces planetside base and drove the survivors into space. Gikkin sought his revenge by recruiting mercenary pilots to replace those who had been killed &mdash; after capturing a [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B]] frigate. Gikkin sowed dissent between the Empire and Repea by striking at both sides with disguised ships, and eventually a pair of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] delivered the message of vengeance to Repea that Gikkin could not.

Gikkin was later killed during a sortie. His second-in-command [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Tyrus (pilot)|Tyrus]] took over the position of commander.
